checks.quote: const sec = await sm.send(new GetSecretValueCommand({ SecretId: `clinic-agent/ehr/${clinicId}` }));
checks.note: EHR, payments and SMS credentials are fetched from Secrets Manager at run time with no static-key fallback. The secrets are vendor client secrets or keys, and no federated option is shown for those vendors.

The payments, sms, ehr and sms_signing secrets are plain aws_secretsmanager_secret resources. There is no rotation resource, rotation_lambda or rotation_rules, and no rotation or max-age setting anywhere in the repo. These static secrets have no bounded lifetime or rotation, even though the workload token, the EHR access token and the IRSA session are bounded.
No secret literals found in the Dockerfile, k8s, config, prompts or terraform. The only secret reference is an ARN.

The code only pins the server certificate and sends bearer tokens. The README claims mTLS for the EHR, but no client cert or DPoP is configured. Nothing in the repo states whether the vendors support holder binding.

violates: Show that credentials expire and rotate
note: The static vendor secrets (EHR client secret, payments key, SMS token, SMS signing secret) have no rotation or expiry configured anywhere in the repo.
